Trigger A creature in the spotlight is critically hit by an attack.

A tiny burst of hardlight shards causes the target to bleed profusely, often accompanied by a gush of extra fake blood to make the attack look even more devastating. The target takes persistent bleed damage equal to @Damage[(2*@actor.system.skills.performance.rank +@actor.system.abilities.cha.mod)[bleed]]{2 + your Charisma modifier}. This increases to 4 + your Charisma modifier if you are expert in Performance, 6 + your Charisma modifier if you are master in Performance, and 8 + your Charisma modifier if you are Legendary in Performance.
